description: Test suite for FastAPI application dependency injection and header validation, using pytest and FastAPI's TestClient. The file contains fixture definitions and multiple test functions that verify API responses for missing, invalid, and valid headers, as well as the OpenAPI schema endpoint.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a module based on parameter and returns a configured TestClient instance for testing FastAPI endpoints.

methods.name: test_get_no_headers(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the response when no headers are provided; expects validation error with status 422.

methods.name: test_get_invalid_one_header(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the response when the X-Token header is invalid; expects status 400 with appropriate error message.

methods.name: test_get_invalid_second_header(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the response when the X-Key header is invalid; expects status 400 with appropriate error message.

methods.name: test_get_valid_headers(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests successful request with valid X-Token and X-Key headers; expects status 200 and correct response body.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of the OpenAPI schema returned by the FastAPI application.
